RUBOLOGY wasn't given much chance last start when getting too far back from the bad barrier. He again draws out today but he will appreciate getting to the 1400 metres. ICEWATER was a better run last start and he will get every chance from barrier 1. RISK FOR REWARD drops in class but he will need some luck from the bad barrier.
